title: デビュー戦の後に・姫の第一歩

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My debut race is complete! By building experience and getting used to racing, I'm on a direct route to becoming my ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oh, and then after the race, I'm requested to have an interview too! I'm so fired up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure when my next race will be, but I'll be working on building up my fan base in the meantime! Princess☆Stomp! Haaah!
